_readme: Business rules for what counts as a 'Just announced' show. Consumed by
scripts/lib/announce-rules.js, which is used by just-announced.js (feed
flagging), announce-cards.js (local preview cards) and post-announcements.js
(CI autoposter). Matching is case-insensitive substring on the venue name.
A listing is NOTABLE only when ALL of these hold:
1. the show is at least min_days_out days away (announcements are for
shows a few weeks out, not this weekend);
2. the title does not look like a showcase / open mic / recurring series
(regex in announce-rules.js);
3. the same title at the same venue does not repeat across
series_weeks or more distinct weeks in events.json (a headliner
doing Thu-Sat is one week; 'Comedy & Drinks in a Speakeasy' every
Thursday for two months is a series);
4. and one of: venue is a big_room (arenas, stadiums, theaters, music
halls: everything there is a touring headliner); venue is a
headliner_room (clubs that book touring names, still LLM-gated in
CI); or the venue is unlisted but the FACE-VALUE floor price_min is
at least unlisted_venue_min_price (price_max is never used: VIP
tables and bottle service inflate it, which is how The Den's $19
showcases got flagged at $227).
exclude wins over everything (Conroe contains 'the riot comedy club').
